question: How do I find a tutor?
answer: You can find tutors two ways: click 'Find Tutors' in the navigation or 'Browse Tutors' on the homepage. You can filter by subject, grade level, hourly rate, and minimum rating, then click 'View Profile' to see a tutor's full details including availability and courses.

question: What subjects are available for tutoring?
answer: EdKonnect Academy offers tutoring in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English, History, Computer Science, Spanish, French, Art, and Music. You can browse subjects on the Find Tutors or Browse Courses page.

question: How do I browse courses?
answer: Click 'Browse Courses' in the navigation or on the homepage. You can search by course name, filter by subject and grade level, and sort by price. Each course card shows the price, duration, sessions per week, and total sessions.

question: What grade levels are supported?
answer: The platform supports Elementary School, Middle School, High School, College, and Adult Education students. You can filter tutors and courses by grade level on the Find Tutors and Browse Courses pages.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Click 'Contact Support' on the homepage FAQ section, or email us at support@edkonnect.com. You can also reach your assigned coordinator through the Messages section in your dashboard.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click 'Sign Up' in the navigation or on the homepage. Fill in your First Name, Last Name, Email Address, and Password. You can also add a Phone Number and Educational Needs note. Select your timezone and submit. You'll receive a setup email to complete your account.

question: Can I sign up as a parent or tutor?
answer: Yes. When signing up, you create a general account. To become a tutor, visit the Tutor Registration page (/tutor-registration) and submit your application. Parents can start booking sessions right after account setup.

question: I haven't received my account setup link. What should I do?
answer: On the Login page, click 'Haven't received your account setup link?' at the bottom. Enter your email and click 'Send Setup Link'. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive within a few minutes.

question: How do I log in?
answer: Click 'Sign In' in the navigation or visit /login. Enter your email and password. Check 'Remember me' to stay logged in. After login you'll be redirected to your role-specific dashboard.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: On the login page, you can request a new setup link by clicking 'Haven't received your account setup link?' and entering your email. A password reset link will be sent to you. Follow the link to set a new password.

question: How do I update my profile information?
keywords: my email address on my account
answer: Log in and go to your Dashboard. Navigate to the Profile or Account tab where you can update your personal details, contact information, and preferences.

question: How do I change my timezone?
answer: Your timezone is set during sign-up and can be updated in your account settings. The platform auto-detects your timezone when you sign up — you can override it with the timezone selector dropdown.

question: How do I book a tutor?
answer: Go to Browse Courses, select a course, and click 'View Details'. On the course detail page, click 'Enroll Now'. Fill in your student's name and grade level, choose a payment method (Full, Installments, or Pay Later), and confirm. After enrolling, you can book your first session.

question: How do I enroll in a course?
answer: On any course detail page, click 'Enroll Now'. An enrollment dialog opens where you enter your student's First Name, Last Name, and Grade Level. You can also select an existing student from previous enrollments. Choose your payment method and confirm.

question: Can I book a trial lesson?
answer: Yes! On a course detail page, each assigned tutor has a 'Book Trial Lesson' button. You can book up to 2 trial lessons per account. A bookable calendar appears to pick your preferred time slot.

question: Can I book a recurring session?
answer: Yes, recurring session booking is supported. During the session scheduling flow in your Parent Dashboard, you can set up recurring sessions at a regular cadence based on the tutor's availability.

question: How do I choose which tutor teaches my course?
answer: On the Course Detail page, you'll see all assigned tutors with their availability. During enrollment, you can optionally select a preferred tutor from the dropdown. Each tutor card also shows their availability and a 'Book Trial Lesson' button so you can try before committing.

question: What courses are available?
keywords: how can i see available courses
answer: Browse all available courses at /courses. You can filter by subject (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English, History, Computer Science, Spanish, French, Art, Music) and grade level, and sort by price.

question: How do I join a session?
answer: Before your session, you'll receive a confirmation email with a Zoom join link. You can also find it in your Parent Dashboard under 'Upcoming Sessions' — click 'Join Session' at your scheduled time.

question: Where do I find my session link?
answer: Your Zoom session link is in two places: the booking confirmation email sent after enrollment, and your Parent Dashboard under 'Upcoming Sessions'. Click 'Join Session' when it's time to start.

question: Where can I see my upcoming sessions?
answer: Log in and go to your Parent Dashboard. Click the 'Sessions' or 'Upcoming Sessions' tab to see all scheduled sessions, including date, time, tutor name, course, and the join link.

question: How do I view past sessions?
answer: In your Parent Dashboard, go to the 'Sessions' tab. Past and completed sessions appear alongside upcoming ones. You can also visit /session-notes to see notes and summaries from previous sessions.

question: Can I see session notes or progress summaries?
answer: Yes! Visit /session-notes or click 'Session Notes' in your dashboard. Notes are grouped by month and show the course, student name, date, and the tutor's progress summary for each session.

question: What happens if a tutor doesn't show up?
answer: If a tutor misses a session, report it immediately through your dashboard or email support@edkonnect.com. You'll receive a full refund for that session and we'll help you rebook with the same or another tutor.

question: How do I reschedule a session?
keywords: change the date of my class
change the date of my session
answer: In your Parent Dashboard, go to 'Upcoming Sessions', find the session you want to change, and click 'Reschedule'. You can also use the management link in your booking confirmation email. Rescheduling depends on the tutor's available slots.

question: What is the rescheduling deadline?
answer: You can reschedule a session up to 24 hours before the scheduled start time. For last-minute changes, contact your tutor directly via Messages or email support@edkonnect.com.

question: How do I manage my booking from an email link?
answer: Your confirmation email contains a 'Manage Booking' link. Clicking it takes you to a page showing full session details — course, tutor, date and time, and duration. From there you can cancel the session if needed.

question: How do I cancel a session?
answer: In your Parent Dashboard, find the session under 'Upcoming Sessions' and click 'Cancel Session'. A confirmation dialog will appear — click 'Yes, Cancel Session' to confirm. You can also cancel via the 'Manage Booking' link in your confirmation email.

question: What is the refund policy for cancelled sessions?
answer: If you cancel more than 24 hours before a session, you'll receive a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours may not be eligible for a refund. Contact support@edkonnect.com for special circumstances.

question: How do I pay for a course?
answer: Payments are made securely during enrollment on the Course Detail page. You'll see three options: 'Pay in Full', 'Pay in 2 Installments' (for courses over $500), or 'Pay Later'. All card payments are processed through Stripe.

question: Can I pay in installments?
answer: Yes! If a course costs more than $500, you'll see a 'Pay in 2 Installments' option during enrollment. This splits your payment into two equal charges.

question: What is the Pay Later option?
answer: The 'Pay Later' option lets you enroll in a course without paying upfront. You'll be invoiced separately. This option appears during the enrollment checkout flow on the Course Detail page.

question: Where can I see my payment history?
answer: Go to your Parent Dashboard and click 'Payments' in the sidebar, or visit /parent/payments. You'll see your full Billing History table with all transactions.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Yes. All payments are processed through Stripe, a PCI-compliant payment provider. Your card details are never stored on our servers.

question: How do I apply to become a tutor?
keywords: how do i become a tutor
how should i register as tutor
want to register as a tutor
apply to join as a tutor
need to apply to be a tutor
answer: Visit the Tutor Registration page at /tutor-registration or click 'Become a Tutor' in the navigation footer. Fill in your Full Name, Email, About You, Qualifications & Education, Years of Experience, Hourly Rate Range, the subjects and grade levels you teach, and your timezone. Click 'Submit Application' and our team will review it.

question: What information do I need to register as a tutor?
keywords: what do i need to apply
answer: You'll need: Full Name, Email Address, About You (bio), Qualifications & Education, Years of Experience, Hourly Rate Range (e.g. '50-80'), the subjects you teach (checkboxes), grade levels you cover, and your timezone. Phone number is optional.

question: How long does tutor application review take?
answer: After submitting your application, our admin team reviews it. You'll be notified by email once your application is approved. Once approved, you can set up your profile, availability, and start accepting bookings.

question: How do I set my availability as a tutor?
keywords: mark as unavailable on certain days
answer: Log in and go to your Tutor Dashboard. Click the 'Availability' tab. Use the Availability Manager to set your weekly available hours by day and time. Students can only book sessions within those time slots.

question: How do I block time off as a tutor?
keywords: block time off on my tutor schedule
answer: In your Tutor Dashboard, go to the 'Availability' tab and use the Time Block Manager to mark specific dates or time ranges as unavailable. These blocks override your regular availability.

question: How do I manage my sessions as a tutor?
answer: In your Tutor Dashboard, go to the 'Sessions' tab. The Sessions Manager shows all your upcoming and past sessions, including student names, course, date, and time.

question: How do tutors get paid?
keywords: request a payout for my sessions
when can i request a payout
answer: After completing sessions, go to your Tutor Dashboard and click the 'Payments' tab or visit /tutor/payments. You'll see completed enrollments listed under 'Ready to Request'. Click 'Request Payout' for each enrollment. An admin reviews and approves your payout request.

question: How do I check my payout status?
answer: Go to /tutor/payments or the Payments tab in your Tutor Dashboard. The 'Payout Requests History' section shows all your payout requests with their status: Pending, Approved, or Rejected. If rejected, you'll see admin notes explaining why.

question: How do I upload an introduction video?
keywords: how do i upload my intro video
intro video to my tutor page
answer: In your Tutor Dashboard, go to the Profile section and use the Video Upload Manager to upload your introduction video. This video appears on your tutor profile and course detail pages to help students get to know you.

question: How do I write session notes?
answer: After a session, go to your Tutor Dashboard and find the session in the Sessions tab. You can add a progress summary for that session which parents can view in their Session Notes History.

question: What is my hourly rate and how do I set it?
keywords: how do i set my hourly rate
answer: You set your hourly rate range during tutor registration (e.g. '50-80'). This is displayed on your profile to help parents make a decision. You can update it from your Tutor Dashboard profile settings.

question: What can I see in my Parent Dashboard?
answer: Your Parent Dashboard has multiple tabs: Subscriptions (active enrollments), Bookings, Sessions (upcoming and past), Account settings, and Notifications. You can manage all your children's tutoring from one place.

question: How do I manage multiple students or children?
answer: When enrolling in a course, you can select an existing student from previous enrollments or enter a new student's details. Your Parent Dashboard tracks all students and their respective courses and sessions.

question: How do I leave feedback or a review for a tutor?
answer: After completing sessions, you can leave feedback for your tutor through your Parent Dashboard in the Sessions section. Ratings and reviews appear publicly on the tutor's profile to help other parents.

question: How do I view my subscriptions?
answer: In your Parent Dashboard, click the 'Subscriptions' tab. You'll see all active course enrollments, the tutor assigned, and the current status.

question: How do I manage my notification preferences?
answer: Visit /parent/notifications or click 'Notifications' in your dashboard sidebar. The Notification Settings panel lets you choose what alerts you receive (session reminders, new messages, etc.).

question: How do I send a message to my tutor?
keywords: how do i message my tutor
answer: Go to the Messages page (/messages) from your dashboard. Select the conversation with your tutor and type your message in the input box at the bottom. Press Enter or click the Send button to send.

question: Can I send files in messages?
answer: Yes. In the Messages page, click the paperclip icon next to the message box. You can attach PDF, DOCX, or XLSX files up to 10MB. The recipient can download the file directly from the conversation.

question: How do I send a message to my coordinator?
answer: Go to the Messages page (/messages) from your Parent Dashboard. Your assigned coordinator will appear in your conversations list. Type your message and send — coordinators typically reply within a few hours.

question: How do I search my conversations?
answer: On the Messages page, there's a search bar at the top of the conversations list. Type a name or keyword to filter your conversations.

question: How do admins approve tutors?
answer: In the Admin Dashboard (/admin/dashboard), go to the 'Tutors' tab. The Registered Tutors Manager lists all tutor applications. Admins can review each application and approve or reject it from there.

question: How do admins manage users?
answer: Admins access the Admin Dashboard at /admin/dashboard. The 'Users' tab shows all registered users. Admins can view user details, roles, and manage accounts.

question: How do admins manage courses?
answer: In the Admin Dashboard, go to the 'Courses' tab. Admins can use the Course Creation Form to create new courses and manage existing ones, including assigning tutors to courses.

question: How do admins view platform analytics?
answer: The Admin Dashboard 'Statistics' tab shows User Growth, Enrollment Patterns, Revenue Trends, and User Distribution charts. Admins can also use the Date Range Selector to filter analytics and export data as CSV.

question: How do admins approve payout requests?
answer: In the Admin Dashboard, go to the 'Payments' tab. All tutor payout requests appear here with their status. Admins can approve or reject each request and add notes for rejected requests.

question: How do coordinators work on the platform?
answer: Coordinators are assigned to specific parent families. They can view assigned families, monitor their sessions via the Schedule view, and communicate directly with parents through the Messages system. Coordinators log in at /coordinator/dashboard.

question: What is the format of sessions?
answer: All sessions are conducted online via Zoom. Each session's duration is set at the course level (shown in the course details as minutes). You receive a Zoom link in your confirmation email and in your dashboard before each session.

question: How do I download session notes or curriculum?
answer: On a Course Detail page, click the 'Download PDF' button in the Curriculum Details card to download the full curriculum. Session notes are viewable at /session-notes and are summarized by the tutor after each class.

question: What happens after I enroll in a course?
answer: After enrolling, you'll receive a confirmation email. You'll then be prompted to schedule your first session using the tutor's available time slots. You can also book trial lessons with assigned tutors from the Course Detail page.

question: How do I view my tutor profile as others see it?
answer: Your public tutor profile is at /tutor-profile/{your-id}. It shows your name, experience, hourly rate, rating, About Me, Qualifications, subjects, grade levels, and contact email. This is what parents see when browsing tutors.

question: How do I schedule a session?
answer: Go to your Parent Dashboard and use the Appointment Scheduler. Select a course, student, and tutor, then choose a time slot from the tutor's available calendar and confirm. You can also book sessions directly from the Course Detail page after enrolling.
